description.en: Fades the map's post-process/overlay effect (a full-screen effect layered over the map, such as a darkening or blur used to focus attention on a dialogue) to a target intensity over a duration.
Target intensity to fade to (0.0 to 1.0).

example.code:
// Fade the map effect fully in over a slow duration
CMND_MAP_EFFECT_FADE(1.0, EV_FADE_SLOW);
